title: Read-only impersonation 403 on POST-with-body read endpoints: add exact-action allowlist entry
answers: Support impersonation read-only gets 403 impersonation_read_only on workflow audience count
Blast radius / audience size never loads while impersonating
POST read endpoint blocked during read-only impersonation session
body:
Symptom: Support staff in a read-only impersonation session cannot load the workflow audience count; the request fails with `403 impersonation_read_only`.
Root cause: `ImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware` in posthog/middleware.py rejects every non-idempotent method before the viewset runs, and `POST hog_flows/user_blast_radius` uses POST only because filters are too large for a query string.
Fix pattern: add one `("POST", re.compile(...))` entry to `READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS` in posthog/middleware.py naming the single action, with `/?$` and the `(environments|projects)/([0-9]+|@current)` prefix like the neighbouring entries.
Constraints: only for actions verified to write nothing (no DB writes, no spending of tokens). Do not change how read-only is decided (e.g. viewset-declared read-only actions); the allowlist is deliberately fail-closed and security-reviewed. Sibling `POST feature_flags/user_blast_radius` has the same shape (fixed separately in #105805).
applies: posthog/middleware.py read-only impersonation allowlist; POST-as-read endpoints
